mapper.select: SELECT CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE #{zoneId} AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COUNT(DISTINCT remote_addr) AS visitorCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_method_type = 'POST' AND request_uri LIKE '/api/post/%/view') AS postViewCount FROM tb_system_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND status = 'SUCC' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.id AS id, p.subject AS subject, cat.name AS categoryName, v.view_count AS viewCount, v.visitor_count AS visitorCount FROM ( SELECT CAST(substring(l.request_uri from '^/api/post/([0-9]+)/view$') AS BIGINT) AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.remote_addr) AS visitor_count FROM tb_system_log l WHERE l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{to} AND l.status = 'SUCC' AND l.http_method_type = 'POST' AND l.request_uri LIKE '/api/post/%/view' GROUP BY 1 ) v JOIN tb_post p ON p.id = v.post_id LEFT JOIN tb_category cat ON p.category_id = cat.id WHERE p.status = 'PUB' AND p.public_access = true ORDER BY v.view_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM tb_system_log WHERE status = 'SUCC' AND http_method_type = 'POST' AND request_uri LIKE '/api/post/%/view'

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{recentFrom}) AS recentRequestCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{recentFrom} AND status = 'FAIL') AS recentErrorCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at < #{recentFrom}) AS previousRequestCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at < #{recentFrom} AND status = 'FAIL') AS previousErrorCount FROM tb_system_log WHERE created_at >= #{previousFrom} AND created_at < #{now}

SELECT id AS id, created_at AS createdAt, trace_id AS traceId, request_uri AS requestUri, controller_name AS controllerName, method_name AS methodName, http_method_type AS httpMethodType, remote_addr AS remoteAddr, process_time AS processTime, LEFT(split_part(stack_trace, E'\n', 1), 500) AS stackTraceHead FROM tb_system_log WHERE status = 'FAIL' AND created_at >= #{from} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT regexp_replace(request_uri, '/[0-9]+', '/{id}', 'g') AS uriPattern, http_method_type AS httpMethodType, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, ROUND(AVG(process_time))::bigint AS avgProcessTime, (PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY process_time))::bigint AS p95ProcessTime, MAX(process_time) AS maxProcessTime FROM tb_system_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND process_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minSamples} ORDER BY p95ProcessTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name AS name, locked_at AS lockedAt, lock_until AS lockUntil, locked_by AS lockedBy FROM shedlock

SELECT regexp_replace(split_part(request_uri, '?', 1), '/[0-9]+', '/{id}', 'g') AS uriPattern, http_method_type AS httpMethodType, COUNT(*) AS callCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE response_status IS NULL OR LEFT(response_status, 1) NOT IN ('2','3')) AS failureCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(process_time)), 0)::bigint AS avgProcessTime, MAX(created_at) AS lastCalledAt FROM tb_api_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE response_status IS NULL OR LEFT(response_status, 1) NOT IN ('2','3')) > 0 ORDER BY failureCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
